newsitem.title: UK: IPE June natgas goes off board in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: IPE June natgas goes off board in quiet trade.

text.p: The front month IPE June natural gas contract expired quietly on Thursday as traders decided to leave their positions unchanged.
Any exchange-for-physical deals and the exact physical delivery against the June contract will be released tomorrow, a spokeswoman for the IPE said.
Open interest on June at the end of trading on Wednesday was 185 lots, equivalent to 185,000 therms a day, or 5,550,000 therms over the whole month.
The afternoon session added no deals to morning trade which was confined to 20 lots changing hands in the second quarter next year.
The market was in general better offered than bid across the forward curve, but levels were little changed from Wednesday.
"It is still extraordinarily thin," said one broker. He said the exit recently of FIMAT, one of the key brokers in the gas futures market, had dampened activity.
